root_cause.text: A memory leak exists in the `iris_hfi_gen1_session_unset_buffers` function of the Qualcomm Iris media driver because internal buffer allocations are not destroyed after receiving a successful release response from the firmware.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `ret = iris_destroy_internal_buffer(inst, buf);` immediately following `iris_wait_for_session_response` returning success, directly addressing the CVE description stating "After the firmware releases internal buffers, the driver was not destroying them," which resulted in "stale allocations that were no longer used."
